name: PIR Motion Sensor
description: Like thermal vision! Senses shifts in infrared heat radiated by moving human or animal bodies.
realWorldAnalogy: Like thermal vision! Senses shifts in infrared heat radiated by moving human or animal bodies.
wiringGuidance: Connect VCC (Red wire) to 5V, GND (Dark Slate wire) to GND, and OUT (Green wire) to digital pin 2.
commonMistakes: Testing immediately after power-up—PIR sensors require a 30 to 60-second warm-up calibration cycle.
Confusing the time delay and sensitivity trim potentiometers on the board.

miniExperiment.title: Motion Sentry Alarm
miniExperiment.circuit: VCC to 5V, GND to GND, OUT to Pin 2.
miniExperiment.expectedOutput: Pin 13 LED turns ON and Serial prints 'MOTION DETECTED!' whenever a person moves in front of the Fresnel lens.
